derivation: The action is clarify and the oracle expects clarify, so actionCorrect is true.
decidingTokens is [quality, coverage]. The reason carries both words outright, so tokensFound is 2 of 2: the
reason names the ambiguity correctly and it is the question that fails.
candidateCodes is [RV, TR]. Each is matched by its code as a whole word, by its workflow name, or by its menu
label. The question carries none of the six spellings, so candidatesNamed is 0 and clarifyOk is false. A
clarification is only a clarification when it names what it is between.
